title: NGINX include is reported, never followed or widened into a fallback
claims: an unresolved include is reported as an error or warning
paths the include might have defined are not forwarded
the explicitly declared /known/ location keeps routing when emitted
not_claimed: resolution of includes inside the input directory (input is a single file)
source_semantics: nginx 'include' with a glob that matches no file contributes nothing; /extra/x therefore has no location and answers 404. The converter reads only the given file, so the include is unknown content that must be surfaced rather than guessed.
